topic: Cheetah and peregrine falcon speed comparison
title: Cheetah vs Peregrine Falcon: The Fastest Animal Ever
description:
The cheetah is the fastest land animal, but the peregrine falcon is far faster in a dive. Compare their speeds and scores.

#cheetah #peregrinefalcon #animals #shorts

scenes.narration: The fastest animal on land meets the fastest animal in the sky. Who wins?

visual.prompt: a cheetah sprinting across golden savanna grass with dust trailing, low angle, sharp motion

scenes.narration: A cheetah can reach around 100 kilometers per hour, and it speeds up from a standstill within just a few seconds.

visual.prompt: a cheetah mid-stride with all four feet off the ground, side view, savanna sunrise

scenes.narration: But that speed is a short burst. The chase usually lasts only a few hundred meters before the cat is exhausted.

visual.prompt: a tired cheetah panting in the grass after a chase, close shot, warm light

scenes.narration: The peregrine falcon folds its wings and dives, in a move called a stoop, at over three hundred kilometers per hour.

visual.prompt: a peregrine falcon diving steeply with wings tucked against a bright sky, dramatic angle

scenes.narration: Its nostrils have small bony cones that help it breathe at that speed, and it strikes prey in midair.

visual.prompt: a peregrine falcon perched on a cliff edge, head turned, sharp feather detail

scenes.narration: Speed score: cheetah nine, falcon ten. Endurance score: cheetah three, falcon seven.

visual.prompt: a split scene with a cheetah on grass below and a falcon high in the sky above, wide shot

scenes.narration: In a straight dive, the falcon wins. But on the ground, nothing beats the cheetah. Who gets your vote?

visual.prompt: a hawk soaring above an open savanna at dusk, wide shot, warm sky
